name: harness-event-exited
notes: Sources/PhoneDSHAgentCore/AgentHarness.swift:410-411 and 490-494: exited is the in-band end of a session stream and carries no seq because it is a transport fact, not a journal record. A stream that ends for any other reason terminates with a harness error instead (AgentHarness.swift:492-494).
